Package Controllers

Class GameEngine

java.lang.Object
Controllers.GameEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GameEngine extends Object implements Serializable
The GameEngine class acts as the entry point of the Game and keeps the track of current Game State.
